scenes.line1: How do you keep CSS maintainable?
scenes.say: How do you keep your CSS maintainable and flexible? What are custom properties?

scenes.label: Variables
scenes.say: CSS custom properties use the dash dash var name syntax. They're just variables for your styles.
Define variables in the root selector for global scope. Then use them with the var function, like this.
Custom properties are dynamic and can be scoped. Preprocessor variables are static and only work at compile time.

scenes.question: Are custom properties always global?
scenes.right: No, they can be scoped to elements, not just global.
scenes.say: Are custom properties always global? Nope, you can scope them to specific elements, not just the root.
